title: Mum Called Me For Dinner. She Was At Work. (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you're home alone after school, playing games in your room.
The house smells like your favourite curry.
"Dinner's ready!" your mum calls from the kitchen.
You smile. She came home early. Best day ever.
Your phone buzzes. It's a text. From Mum.
"Stuck at work till late. Order something, sorry love."
Downstairs, a spoon taps a plate.
"Your food is getting cold," the voice calls. Sweet. Patient.
You look at the bedroom door. It's open a crack.
The hallway is dark. Only the kitchen light is on.
You text Mum back: "Then who is in the kitchen?"
The voice calls again, a little closer now.
"I made it just the way you like it."
*Then your phone buzzes again. From Mum. "Don't eat it."
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
